steps.name: llm-schemas
steps.summary: REQUIREMENTS_SCHEMA·VERDICTS_SCHEMA와 parseRequirements·parseVerdicts를 export하고 ParseOutcome<T> { items: T[]; errors: string[] } 형태로 항목별 검증 결과를 제공한다.

steps.name: verdict-aggregation
steps.summary: AnalysisItem { requirement, bucket, evidence, confidence, suggestion, suggestionEvidence } · AnalysisResult { covered, implicit, missing, unjudged }와 buildAnalysis(requirements: Requirement[], verdicts: Verdict[], evidence: ResumeEvidence[]): AnalysisResult를 제공한다.

steps.name: prompts
steps.summary: buildExtractRequirementsPrompt(postingText: string): string · buildMatchVerdictsPrompt(requirements: Requirement[], evidence: ResumeEvidence[], onlyRequirementIds?: string[]): string · MAX_EVIDENCE_ITEMS · MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS를 제공한다.

steps.name: openai-service
steps.summary: extractRequirements(postingText: string, deps?: LlmDeps)와 matchVerdicts(requirements: Requirement[], evidence: ResumeEvidence[], deps?: LlmDeps)를 제공하고 OPENAI_MODEL='gpt-5'로 통일하며 판정 누락분만 한 번 재시도한다.

steps.name: analyze-route-full
steps.summary: AnalyzeResponse의 ok 갈래를 { status: 'ok', posting: { title, sourceUrl? }, requirementCount, result: AnalysisResult }로 확장하고 요구사항 추출·매칭·검증 집계를 Route Handler에 연결한다.
